verdict.rationale: Cursor's security page documents Privacy Mode, which any user (free or Pro) can enable, and team or enterprise admins can enforce. New team members inherit it, and Cursor states that when it is enabled 'we will not train on your data.' ISO 42001 and SOC 2 certifications add some governance backing to this posture. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that Privacy Mode covers Bugbot's PR-diff and comment processing, details on retention or zero-retention with model providers, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
